title: Spyglass Has Arrived!
summary: We're excited to announce the official launch of Spyglass, providing you with powerful new tools for unparalleled clarity and control.

title: Enhanced File Management
summary: Gain complete control over how you manage and display your images and files directly within the editor, streamlining your content creation process.

title: Public Product Roadmap
summary: Stay informed with our new public roadmap, providing a clear overview of recently completed features, upcoming developments, and future plans.

title: Seamless Checkbox Experience
summary: We've significantly enhanced our in-editor checkboxes, making them easier to click, visually consistent with our modern design, and fully draggable for effortless organization.

title: Seamless Collaborative Editing
summary: Enjoy a more fluid and intuitive co-editing experience, making it easier than ever to create and work together in real-time.

title: Enhanced Shared Content Discovery
summary: We've significantly improved how you find and interact with shared ideas and quests, ensuring all relevant content is easily discoverable.

title: Noeko Goes Open Source!
summary: We are incredibly excited to open Noeko's codebase, giving our community unprecedented control, direct involvement, and full transparency in shaping the project's future.

title: Global Language Support
summary: Experience Noeko in your preferred language as we introduce comprehensive international language support to serve users worldwide.

title: Elevate Your Workspace with New Themes
summary: Personalize your Noeko experience with an expanded and refined selection of stunning themes, crafted for both style and usability.

title: Enhanced Knowledge Map for Smarter Exploration
summary: Gain deeper insights and navigate your content with ease by applying powerful new filters to your visual knowledge map, including tags, timeframes, and shared connections.

title: Master Your Knowledge with Dynamic Search & Custom Collections
summary: Discover and organize your information effortlessly with powerful new search filters, advanced sorting options, and the ability to save custom collections of your most relevant knowledge.

title: Dynamic Content Linking
summary: Unleash the full potential of your notes with dynamic new ways to display and interact with connected content, reflecting how you naturally think.

title: Noeko Self-Hosting and Premium Features
summary: Gain ultimate control over your data and access advanced capabilities with Noeko's new self-hosting option and upcoming flexible premium plans.

title: Smarter Time-Based Greetings
summary: We are ensuring our app's greetings precisely reflect the current time of day, enhancing your personalized experience with every visit.

title: Efficient Tag Management & Bulk Actions
summary: This enhancement allows you to swiftly unapply tags and perform other useful actions directly on items from within the tag view, dramatically streamlining your workflow.

title: Expand Your Information Sources
summary: Soon, you'll be able to effortlessly import and interact with a wider range of content, including YouTube videos, websites, and text, making your research and organization more comprehensive than ever.
